summary: The PR addresses the issue of a confusing deprecation warning when empty data is passed to an axis with category units. However, there are some concerns regarding test adequacy and potential behavioral regression.

issues.description: The PR does not include additional tests to verify the behavior with different types of empty inputs or other edge cases.
The change might introduce a behavioral regression if there are other code paths that rely on the current behavior of raising a deprecation warning for empty data.
